tools_used.diarization: Custom pipeline using VAD + MFCC features + Hierarchical Clustering

notes: Diarization pipeline: 1) Extract audio from video using ffmpeg, 2) Apply Silero VAD to detect speech segments (14 segments found), 3) Extract MFCC features from each segment, 4) Normalize features using StandardScaler, 5) Apply hierarchical clustering (Ward linkage, 2 clusters) to identify speakers, 6) Transcribe each segment using Whisper base model, 7) Generate RTTM and ASS subtitle files with speaker labels. Total speech time: 12.78 seconds out of 69.06 seconds audio duration. Detected 2 speakers: spk00 (11 segments) and spk01 (3 segments).
